ValidationRule.description: Aadhaar number must be exactly 12 digits and contain only numbers.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISBLANK(EYI_Aadhar__c) ), NOT(REGEX(EYI_Aadhar__c, "^[0-9]{12}$")), EYI_IsAutomationBypassed__c = FALSE )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Aadhaar number must be exactly 12 digits and contain only numbers.
